# Manual Development — ChatGPT Tech Lead PR review checklist v1.0

**Applies to:** ChatGPT Tech Lead reviewing manual Coder Draft PRs for this repository. Product runtime role specifications do not add review steps here.

**Authority:** Owner/TL-approved task and [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md); the relevant [engineering standards](../conventions/engineering-standards.md) sections and observed CI/PR evidence. Review proportionately; do not invent gates.

## Review the exact snapshot

- [ ] Open the **authoritative Notion task** for approved AC, base, write allowlist, publish permission and Owner decisions; do not rely on those fields copied into PR/Comments. Record task ID, review round, exact PR HEAD and evidence limitations.
- [ ] Review **complete approved-base and PR-base diffs**, task AC, shared contracts and the Coder's **checked self-review in the PR description**. Verify Draft state and GitHub CI on the **exact reviewed HEAD**.
- [ ] **Handoff evidence:** Use the [PR handoff](handoff.md) for AC IDs/code references, checked self-review, commands/exits/skips, tested SHA and risks; cross-check against real diff, tests and CI. Do not require copied Notion AC or a per-task evidence file. Required missing/unverified evidence still blocks approval.
- [ ] For changed Python files, verify Ruff check/format actually covered the relevant **PR diff**; a push event may contain only a docs-only latest commit. Distinguish **push CI on PR HEAD** from **pull_request CI on synthetic merge SHA**; verify jobs, checked SHA, event and scope rather than accepting a green badge alone.
- [ ] **Protected paths and CI integrity:** If the PR touches `AGENTS.md`, `.github/workflows/**`, CI/security scripts/tests, `architecture/policy.toml`, Ruff config, migrations, shared APIs or credential boundaries, verify explicit TL + Owner authorization. Compare gate/config changes against the approved base and require trustworthy independent validation; **CI success generated by PR-modified checks is not sufficient by itself**.
- [ ] For PostgreSQL changes, check the [Session/query/transaction ownership rules](../conventions/engineering-standards.md#postgresql-session-query-and-transaction-ownership) **against the actual merged API at the authorized base**. Flag newly duplicated ownership, invalid nested commits, unsafe SQL, leaked ORM entities, regression in lock/timeout/rollback/UoW; do **not** require unmerged `DB-STD-01` APIs or unrelated cleanup. Verify justified exceptions and live PG evidence when the AC changes PG behavior.
- [ ] Check the following groups, recording **PASS / FAIL / N/A / NOT VERIFIED** with brief supporting evidence. An N/A or NOT VERIFIED needs a reason.

| Area | Questions to verify |
| --- | --- |
| **1. Scope & requirements** | Every AC covered? Only authorized paths? No accidental public API, behavior, migration or runtime changes? |
| **2. Clean Code & maintainability** | KISS, YAGNI and meaningful DRY? Small cohesive functions, clear names/types/errors, readable flow, no dead code/magic values or unjustified abstraction? Did Dev proactively fix within-scope self-review defects? |
| **3. Architecture & design** | Module ownership and dependency direction preserved? Separation of concerns, justified interfaces and minimal coupling/blast radius? |
| **4. Security & trust boundaries** | Validation, fail-closed failures, secrets/logs, permissions, path safety, Docker/network/subprocess/SQL boundaries and authorization invariants? |
| **5. Correctness & reliability** | Happy/error/edge cases, compatibility, transactions/rollback, idempotency, cleanup, timeouts, concurrency/restart when applicable? |
| **6. Tests & CI evidence** | Meaningful positive/negative/boundary/regression cases; deterministic tests; architecture gate and required CI tied to current SHA; skips/gaps disclosed? |
| **7. Operations & documentation** | Safe config/defaults, diagnosable nonsecret errors, runbooks, recovery/rollback and platform compatibility when applicable? |

## Findings and verdict

- [ ] Every actionable finding names **severity, file/line, concrete evidence, affected AC/risk and smallest viable remediation**. Distinguish demonstrated defects from suggestions.
- [ ] Classify: **BLOCKER** (security/authorization breach, data loss, critical AC failure), **MAJOR** (material regression/high-risk omission), **MINOR** (limited maintainability/testability impact), **SUGGESTION** (optional improvement). Do not block only for a preferred style/pattern.
- [ ] Confirm outstanding BLOCKER/MAJOR findings and incomplete mandatory evidence cannot be called APPROVED. Minor/advisory issues are recorded proportionally; avoid quota-consuming cosmetic rework.
- [ ] Submit a **SHA-bound verdict** (`APPROVED`, `CHANGES REQUESTED` or `BLOCKED` for missing evidence); follow the [manual TL review policy](../review-policy.md) for review rounds/escalation, **not** the product's QC/CI retry counters. A subsequent HEAD change invalidates previous approval.
- [ ] Put all file/line findings and the SHA-bound review verdict **only in GitHub PR Review**. Post a short **Notion Comment** `CHANGES_REQUESTED / APPROVED — PR #n — <review-link>`; update the task's managed status/approval fields only through authorized task changes. Never duplicate review findings, test logs or AC in comments.
- [ ] **Actor provenance:** Verify the actual GitHub and Notion authenticated account/App that performed the action. A `ChatGPT Tech Lead` signature is not independent bot authentication. If connected as Owner, disclose that attribution, **never count it as Owner approval**, and wait for separately authenticated Owner merge authority. Dedicated least-privilege TL GitHub/Notion identities are a separately configured integration, not made real by these docs.
- [ ] **Only Owner** authorizes merge; TL re-verifies merge before the next dependent task.

**Manual repository development flow:** TL task → Codex code/tests/self-review → Draft PR → GitHub CI → ChatGPT TL review → Owner merge → TL verifies. Do not require QC/MTP, Planning Package hashes or a separate Codex Reviewer to develop the product.
